name: orchestrator
description: Tasks that split into parts with known answers, so code can score the split, each worker, and the merge. Each part has a key (a regex) that finds its subtask and its place in an answer. The last case can't be split: each step needs the one before.

cases.prompt: How many times does the letter r appear in each of these words: strawberry, berry, mirror, carrot? Give one line per word.

parts.name: strawberry
parts.q: How many times does the letter r appear in strawberry?

parts.name: berry
parts.q: How many times does the letter r appear in berry?

parts.name: mirror
parts.q: How many times does the letter r appear in mirror?

parts.name: carrot
parts.q: How many times does the letter r appear in carrot?

cases.prompt: Work out 17 times 23, 144 divided by 12, and 15% of 80. Give each result, then the total of the three results.
What are the capitals of Australia, Canada, Brazil and Turkey? Give one line per country.
Give the chemical symbols for gold, silver, iron and sodium, one line per element.
Count the letters in the words banana, apple and cherry. Give each count, then the total of the three counts.

parts.name: banana
parts.q: How many letters are in banana?

parts.name: apple
parts.q: How many letters are in apple?

parts.name: cherry
parts.q: How many letters are in cherry?

cases.prompt: Convert 2 kilograms, 0.5 kilograms and 3.2 kilograms to grams. Give each conversion, then the total in grams.

Answer each, numbered 1 to 3. 1) Which is heavier, a kilogram of feathers or a kilogram of steel? 2) In a race, you pass the person in second place. What place are you in now? 3) How many months of the year have 28 days?

parts.name: 3) months
parts.q: How many months of the year have 28 days?
